thought.text: The integration tests use a local HTTP server (no external network needed). Running the full test suite now.

reasoning_content: Alright — the integration tests spin up a local HTTP server on port 8000 and serve from tests/data/ — no external network needed. Let's run the full test suite. This should let us thoroughly verify the installation. I'll run it with coverage as per the README.

action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup python3 -m poetry run coverage run -m unittest --buffer > /tmp/tests.log 2>&1 &
echo "started $!"
